# 🚀 Next.js Starter

This is a minimal **Next.js 14+** starter template.

## 🧩 Features
- App router
- Minimal structure
- Fast development setup

## 🧠 Commands
```bash
npm install
npm run dev
```

App runs at [http://localhost:3000](http://localhost:3000)
